source_refs.note: Exercise 7.1, Question 1: book page 125 (PDF 130); answer key book page 301 (PDF 306): 12 kinds of rolls (agrees)

blocks.prompt: 1. Let us make paratha roll. We can choose our fillings from the following: Meat: Chicken or beef; Vegetable: Onions, tomatoes or cucumber; Sauce: Mayo or Chutney. How many different kinds of rolls can we make?
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle samajhte hain ke roll banta kaise hai: teen marhalon (stages) mein. Pehle meat chunna hai, phir vegetable, phir sauce.
Find kya karna hai? Kul kitne mukhtalif (different) rolls ban sakte hain.
Rule kaunsa? Fundamental Principle of Counting (ginti ka bunyadi usool): har marhale ke options ginein aur unhein multiply kar dein. Jama nahi, multiply, kyunke har choice doosri har choice ke saath jurti hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: meat ke 2 options (chicken, beef); vegetable ke 3 options (onions, tomatoes, cucumber); sauce ke 2 options (mayo, chutney).
Humein find karna hai: kul kitne kisam ke rolls ban sakte hain.
Tareeqa: Fundamental Principle of Counting. Agar ek kaam \(m\) tareeqon se, doosra \(n\) tareeqon se aur teesra \(p\) tareeqon se ho sakta hai, aur yeh kaam ek doosre par asar nahi daalte (independent hain), to teeno mil kar \(m \times n \times p\) tareeqon se hote hain.

Har marhale ke options ginein
\[\text{meat} = 2,\quad \text{vegetable} = 3\]
\[\text{sauce} = 2\]
Kyun: Har group se sirf ek cheez leni hai. Chicken lene se vegetables ya sauces ke options kam ya zyada nahi hote, is liye yeh teeno marhale independent hain. Yahi shart Fundamental Principle lagane ke liye zaroori hai.

Options ko multiply karein
\[\text{rolls} = 2 \times 3 \times 2\]
\[= 6 \times 2 = 12\]
Kyun: Har meat har vegetable ke saath ja sakta hai, to meat aur vegetable ke \(2 \times 3 = 6\) jore bante hain. Phir in 6 joron mein se har ek ke saath 2 sauces lag sakti hain, is liye 6 ke do guna yani 12.
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students \(2 + 3 + 2 = 7\) likh dete hain. Jama tab karte hain jab sirf EK group se cheez leni ho; jab har group se ek ek cheez leni ho to multiply karte hain.

Tasdeeq: ek shaakh (branch) gin kar dekhein
\[\text{Chicken: } 3 \times 2 = 6 \text{ rolls}\]
\[\text{Beef: } 3 \times 2 = 6 \text{ rolls}\]
\[6 + 6 = 12 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Chicken ke saath yeh rolls bante hain: onion-mayo, onion-chutney, tomato-mayo, tomato-chutney, cucumber-mayo, cucumber-chutney, yani 6. Beef ke saath bhi bilkul yahi 6. Kul 12, wohi jawab jo multiply karne se aaya, is liye jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(12\) mukhtalif kisam ke rolls ban sakte hain.
